Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
With the unending debate of whether or not Ashur should be trumped, I exhumed an old card I designed a while ago.

Name: Inconnu Monitors
Cardtype: Event
Inconnu. Do not replace until a Methuselah's ash heap is empty.
During each Methuselah's untap phase, he or she may remove up to two cards from any Methuselah's ash heap.

It's slower than Trochomancy but more consistent and vulnerable to Not to be or the Uncoiling. And it totally kills the Yong-Sun, Harmonist tournament-winning archetype.

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director

Messages.Author: jamesatzephyr
Messages.Body:
> Reyda wrote:
> Nice, but would'nt it be possible to handle ashur with the cards already in printed ? My guess is yes, but your mileage may vary...

Even if the answer is yes, it might only be yes for some deck types. Adding methods of screwing with Ashur (and possibly also certain uses of Anthelios) to other decks might well be useful. Like adding a new bleed reduction card to Protean wouldn't necessarily imply that bleed wasn't handle-able by other methods.

Messages.Author: Kiddo
